# Anycode v0.2.0

Anycode v0.2.0 is a major milestone release introducing official standalone desktop applications for macOS, Windows, and Linux via Tauri, multi-root workspace support, significant AI Agent/ACP performance optimizations with chat virtualization, and Mermaid diagram rendering.

## Desktop Applications (Tauri)

- **Cross-Platform Installers**: Added official desktop packages for macOS (`.dmg` for Apple Silicon & Intel), Windows (`.exe` NSIS installer & `.msi`), and Linux (`.deb` & standalone `.tar.gz`).
- **Seamless System Integration**: Automatic macOS shell `PATH` inheritance ensuring language servers (LSP) and CLI tools are discovered out-of-the-box.
- **Auto-Updater & Relaunch**: Integrated built-in secure auto-updater with signature verification and in-place relaunch.
- **Desktop UX**: Native window styling, customizable WebGL dynamic background effects, and a dedicated welcome screen.

## Multi-Root Workspaces

- **Multiple Projects**: Open and manage multiple folder roots within a single workspace session.
- **Scoped Operations**: Git status, search, and file watchers automatically scope to their respective project roots without cross-talk.

## AI Agent & ACP (Agent Client Protocol)

- **Virtualized Chat Rendering**: Fully virtualized message and turn rendering, enabling fluid scrolling and zero lag even in extensive agent conversations.
- **ACP Terminal Tool Calls**: Agents can now execute commands and interact with terminal sessions directly.
- **Visual Status & Avatars**: Added custom and default agent avatars, user profile avatars, and a real-time breathing pulse animation indicating active agent processing.
- **Prompt Safety & Queueing**: Added prompt deduplication, queue reordering, and graceful cancellation without race conditions.
- **Scroll & View State Restoration**: Preserved scroll offsets and virtualization state across tab switches and search jumps.

## Markdown & Diagrams

- **Mermaid Support**: Added interactive Mermaid diagram rendering inside the live Markdown preview panel and ACP chat messages.

## Editor & Diff Viewer

- **Remote Edit Stability**: Preserved cursor position and active text selection when receiving remote edits and watcher syncs.
- **Enhanced Diffs**: Added deleted lines indicators directly into the editor scrollbar and ghost line numbers in diff views.
- **Default Theme**: Switched default theme to Vesper Dark with an updated syntax palette.

## Reliability & File System

- **Atomic File Saving**: Implemented safe atomic file saving using directory-local temporary files to prevent data corruption during write failures or concurrent access.
- **UTF-8 BOM Preservation**: Cleanly stripped UTF-8 BOM in backend memory buffers and restored it upon saving.
- **Concurrency Locks**: Synchronized disk reads under file-to-code locks to eliminate race conditions between watchers and manual saves.

**Full comparison:** `v0.1.2...v0.2.0`
